next.reason: 1985 only makes the indexed RECORD clause the sequential one. In 2023 FD Format 1 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR5 'Format 1 is the file description entry for a sequential file') and Format 2 (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR7 'Format 2 is the file description entry for a relative file or an indexed file') both use the one record-clause of 13.18.43, whose syntax and general rules make no organization distinction; the sequential-only limits concern LINE SEQUENTIAL and FORMAT, absent from 1985.
